subject: VPC/on-prem architecture deep-dive — scheduling and materials

Subject: VPC/on-prem architecture deep-dive — request and constraints

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the initial call yesterday. We'd like to schedule a 90-minute architecture deep-dive to walk through: VPC connectivity options (Direct Interconnect / VPN), on‑prem network constraints at our primary DC, and IAM/service account boundaries for the integration. Attendees we want on from HealthSys: myself (cloud lead), Diego (networking lead), procurement@healthsys.com (procurement), and our security engineer (sre_team@healthsys.com).

A few constraints on our side: the procurement team has a blackout week the first week of April for contract reviews, and our networking lead is only available mornings (PST) the last week of March.

Attached is a high-level infra diagram to give context — happy to share more before the meeting. Our goal is to validate the proposed private deployment topology and nail down IAM object mapping so we can move to a pilot.

Proposed duration: 90 min (we anticipate live demo + breakout for networking questions). Can you send a couple of slot options or a poll?

Attachments: [attachment: healthsys-infra-overview.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

Thanks,
Alice Moreno

Subject: Re: VPC/on-prem architecture deep-dive — request and constraints

Hi Alice — great summary, and thanks for the diagram. This is exactly the kind of session our SEs prefer to run live.

We can run a 90-minute session with:
- 25–30 min: topology walkthrough and assumptions (Marissa + Karthik)
- 30 min: live demo of connectivity patterns (Karthik)
- 20 min: breakout/network deep-dive with your network lead
- 10–15 min: next steps and action items (procurement & security asks)

I put together a brief agenda and materials folder and attached an editable agenda here. Please add any items we missed.

Slot options (PST):
- Thu 2028-03-30 09:00–10:30
- Fri 2028-03-31 08:30–10:00
- Tue 2028-04-05 10:00–11:30 (in case procurement blackout blocks first week)

If those don't work we can open a quick Doodle — here's the poll: https://doodle.com/poll/rdw-arch-deepdive-availability

Thanks — a couple quick notes from the SE side before we lock time:
- If we will be discussing an on‑prem appliance or customer‑managed gateway, please share IP ranges and NAT expectations ahead of time.
- For the IAM section, a short list of service accounts and expected scopes will make the mapping exercise far more effective.
- If you want us to demo a full private deployment (VPC peering + dedicated inference pool), call out expected token volumes so we can size batch/kv cache expectations.

I can flex my schedule a bit; Thu 3/30 morning works for me.
